description: Enable or disable web push, or set the default notification icon. The first enable generates the workspace's VAPID keys; disabling keeps them so existing browser subscriptions stay valid. The site must serve /sequenzy-sw.js (importScripts of the hosted worker) and call sequenzy.subscribeToPush() from a click.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

defaultIconUrl.description: Default https icon URL; null clears it.

enabled.description: Turn web push on or off.

name: update_web_push_settings

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_web_push_settings` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

siteKey.description: When enabling: the web tracking site key web push uses (publicKey, allowedOrigins, installSnippet), created for the company website if none existed; null when there is none.

siteKeyCreated.description: True when enabling created the site key.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
